_comment: Proposed monthly category benchmarks for team review. Limits use the median observed user-month category expense total from cleaned 2021–2023 records, rounded upward to the nearest 100 units. See docs/budget_policy.md.
currency_note: Amounts are in the dataset's single underlying unit. No currency conversion is performed (§4.5).
comparison_policy: Allow all available months. Label baseline-period comparisons as descriptive comparisons using the same data that generated the limits.
group_policy: Include users with at least one retained dated transaction in the selected month. Sum spending and limits for those same users.
